*.limits.*.percent: The window's own name plus the % unit is the whole statement; what a full window means for the account is carried by warning, limitReached and limits.*.active.
*.credits.used: Name plus the currency unit is the whole statement — how much of the granted budget has gone.
*.credits.limit: Name plus the currency unit is the whole statement — the ceiling the provider granted.
*.credits.remaining: Money still available to spend, in the currency the unit names — the same plain statement at every provider.
*.credits.percent: Used measured against the limit; the name says percent and the unit repeats it.
*.credits.available: The provider's own yes/no on whether the balance still covers calls — the name is that sentence.
*.costs.total: The name carries the only thing that could surprise: this counter runs over the account's lifetime, not over a period.
total.warningsActive: Counts the accounts whose own warning datapoint is true, and that one carries the explanation.
